journey.name: paykit on by default
journey.description: Verifies a new wallet shows Paykit without any change in Dev Settings, and that the Dev Settings switch still turns Paykit off and back on. Precondition: a fresh install of the dev build, onboarded with a new wallet, Dev Settings never opened. Start on the wallet home screen. Toasts never appear in `android layout`; assert them from a screenshot taken right after the tap.

actions.action: Verify the profile button (testTag "ProfileButton") is visible in the home header
Verify Subscriptions (testTag "DrawerSubscriptions") is visible in the drawer
Scroll to the PAYKIT section and verify the Enable Paykit UI switch (testTag "PaykitUiToggle") is on
Tap the Enable Paykit UI switch (testTag "PaykitUiToggle")
Verify the "Paykit UI disabled" toast (testTag "PaykitUiDisabledToast") appears and the switch is off
Tap back (testTag "NavigationBack") until the wallet home screen is visible
Verify the profile button (testTag "ProfileButton") is not visible
Verify Subscriptions (testTag "DrawerSubscriptions") is not visible in the drawer
Tap Settings (testTag "DrawerSettings"), then the Advanced tab (testTag "Tab-advanced"), then Dev Settings (testTag "DevSettings")
Scroll to the PAYKIT section and tap the Enable Paykit UI switch (testTag "PaykitUiToggle")
Tap Enable in the "Enable Paykit UI?" dialog
Verify the "Paykit UI enabled" toast (testTag "PaykitUiEnabledToast") appears and the switch is on
Tap back (testTag "NavigationBack") until the wallet home screen is visible
Verify the profile button (testTag "ProfileButton") is visible
